summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — BTRW.L +4%, LAND.L +4%, RHM.DE +3%, BRBY.L +3%, BAB.L +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (FRES.L -6%, AAF.L -5%, ENR.DE -4%, EDV.L -4%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: FRES.L (-5.82%) — No obvious news catalyst found for 2026-10-15; searches returned nothing dated today. Likely a precious-metals (silver/gold) price pullback hitting the miner, but that is unconfirmed. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: FRES.L is a FTSE 100 Mexican silver/gold miner and no strategy's universe includes it. A long-only bot also has no way to act on a sector-driven drop.
